i.norm: Verifies the detailed Levenshtein distance between a long, all-NUL buffer and a short text, using a threshold large enough not to cut the result off. The left side is a freshly allocated 858-character CharBuffer; allocate() fills it with '�' characters, so none of them match the 10 characters of the right-hand text. Turning the 858-char left sequence into the 10-char right sequence therefore needs: - 848 deletions (858 - 10) to drop the surplus characters, and - 10 substitutions to convert the remaining characters, giving a total distance of 858 (848 + 10).
Threshold equal to the buffer length keeps the full distance from being clipped to -1.
